text: load_delta() tbl_delta() longer accept timestamp. DuckDB’s delta extension accepts TIMESTAMP attach option ignores , callers silently received latest snapshot instead historical one. Account-scoped Azure secrets now scoped account’s actual hosts (abfss://<account>.dfs.core.windows.net/ az://<account>.blob.core.windows.net/) rather abfss://<account>/, matched real URL.
